$comment: The judge model and harness for judge.mjs (rubric) and lib/semantic.mjs (semantic yes/no). The harness (Claude Code CLI) has no sampling-temperature control, so temperature 0 is not set. Determinism comes from the pinned model below, the (question, text) answer cache in runs/semantic-cache/<harness>-<model>.json (calibration fills it, runs reuse it) and the 97% calibration gate: below it the semantic judge is disabled and compare.mjs reports INCONCLUSIVE.
